name: Fizz
description: Goblin from an unknown plane recruited into a war against humans, who became a field chef.

description_citations.text: "Fizz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fizz is recruited into the war against humans by Razgar, joins the 99th Goblin Infantry, then moves to the field kitchens for her talents.
timeline.quote: she soon found herself in the relative safety of the field kitchens

citation.text: "Fizz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ordered to bring the General hot soup, Fizz dashes across the battlefield with the cauldron.
timeline.quote: she picked up the soup cauldron and left the relative safety of her tent behind

citation.text: "Fizz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a human trench one human tastes her soup and dies; the other flees screaming of a chemical attack.
timeline.quote: One human tasted her soup and immediately died.

citation.text: "Fizz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fizz reaches General Razgar and Yort by balloon; the soup is a hit and she is promoted to Field Chef, First Class.
timeline.quote: Fizz immediately got promoted to Field Chef, First Class

citation.text: "Fizz", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
